inventory.bankNoteTotalCounts: record actual bank; not assumed from starting hand

tableModel.geometryMeaning: Official square order/relative sides and colour groups, original simplified outlines/icons. Public table organizer and six external player panels are an original asset arrangement. No Hasbro logo, character art or sculpt tracing.
identityInvariants: One title deed has exactly one owner/Bank; its mortgage face and board building layer describe the same property.
A street carries0–4houses OR one hotel, never both; railroads/utilities have no building anchors.
Jail and JustVisiting share index10 but have different subregions/status. Do not mark every pawn on10as imprisoned.
GetOutOfJailFree cards remain held and outside deck until used/traded/returned to their origin. All other resolved cards go underneath their own deck, not a fake discard pile.
Bank cash is separate even when Banker also plays. Unknown cash/order/owner is null, not inferred0.
Pending transfer/movement/card/auction status prevents double payment or repeating a partially resolved action.
FreeParking is resting only; no house-rule cash pot appears unless explicitly recorded as an agreed variant.

completeStructures: two ordered decks/resolving transactions with no fictional discard
deed/mortgage templates and all8token kinds/all6die faces
assetCompleteness.art: Original neutral own forms; official geometry/order only, no commercial illustration copied.
